ayahs.1: For the accustomed security of Quraysh—
ayahs.2: Their accustomed trading journeys in winter to Yemen and summer to Syria—safe passage others did not enjoy—
ayahs.3: Let them worship the Rabb of this House—the Ka'bah through which their safety and livelihood flowed—
ayahs.4: Who fed them against hunger and secured them against fear.
